title: abutilon dispermum
intro: Abutilon dispermum, commonly known as Indian mallow or Country mallow, is a plant species in the family Malvaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including relieving fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Abutilon dispermum include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which make it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Abutilon dispermum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
